privacy_ask_a_person_to_review: The right to a human review: If PokeFlux bans you from trading or the market automatically, you can ask a member of staff to look at the decision again.
privacy_bot_logs_record: The bot's logs record which command was run, the user ID that ran it, the community and channel IDs, and how long it took. Errors are logged with the same details. These logs are kept for 30 days.
privacy_contact_authority: How to contact the appropriate authority
privacy_dashboard_browser_storage: The website also saves your theme, font, language and sidebar choices in your browser, along with a colour palette taken from your avatar. These are only used to show the site the way you set it up.
privacy_dashboard_sign_in: When you sign in to the website, Fluxer gives it tokens for your account. The website only asks Fluxer for the identify scope, which covers your user ID, username, display name, avatar and banner. It does not ask for your email address or your community list.
privacy_dashboard_tokens_storage: The tokens are encrypted and kept in cookies in your browser, and in a session store on our server together with your basic profile. A session ends after 24 hours without use. Signing out deletes the session and the cookies and tells Fluxer to revoke the refresh token.
privacy_data_kept_until_deleted: Game data does not expire on its own. It is kept until you ask us to delete it.
privacy_deletion_how: PokeFlux does not have a delete command yet. To have your data deleted, contact us at {email} or in the support community at https://fluxer.gg/ROQQFi38 from the Fluxer account the data belongs to. Deleting your data removes your Pokémon and all other progress for good.
privacy_deletion_kept_records: Trade logs and moderation records that involve you, such as fraud check results and staff audit entries, may be kept for 30 days after deletion, so that bans keep working and the other player's records stay complete.
privacy_fluxer_processes: Fluxer itself processes your data when you use PokeFlux, since the bot's messages and the staff log channels are hosted there. Fluxer's own privacy policy covers that.
privacy_hide_from_leaderboard: If you only want to stop other players seeing your stats, use the visible bal command. It hides your trainer card from others and removes you from the public leaderboard.
privacy_how_collect_commands: Use the bot's commands and buttons

privacy_how_collect_messages: Send messages in a channel where PokeFlux spawns Pokémon or hatches eggs
privacy_how_collect_sign_in: Sign in to the website with Fluxer
privacy_how_collect_trading: Trade, send gifts or use the market

privacy_how_do_we_store: How do we store your data?
privacy_how_will_we_use: How will we use your data?
privacy_if_you_have_any_questions: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or the data we hold on you, or you would like to use one of your data protection rights, contact us at {email}.
privacy_if_you_make_a_request: To use any of these rights, contact us at {email}. We aim to reply within one month.
privacy_intro: This privacy policy explains how PokeFlux, the Pokémon game bot for Fluxer, and its website at pokeflux.tech collect and use your data.
privacy_list_bans_and_notes: Moderation records, such as bans, the reasons given for them, and notes staff write about an account
privacy_list_game_data: Your game data, such as your Pokémon, items, currencies, party, eggs, missions, achievements and settings
privacy_list_names: Your username and avatar while you use the website, and the trainer nickname and Pokémon nicknames you choose
privacy_list_risk_scores: Risk scores and flags from automatic trade checks (see Trading and fair play below)
privacy_list_server_ids: The IDs of communities and channels where you use PokeFlux, and the settings community staff choose for it
privacy_list_sign_in_tokens: Sign in tokens issued by Fluxer when you sign in to the website
privacy_list_trades: Trades, gifts and market listings, including who was involved and what changed hands
privacy_logs_staff_channel: Some events are also posted to private staff channels on Fluxer. These include completed trades and market sales, level ups, hunt results and errors. When PokeFlux joins a community, it posts the community's name, ID, member count and owner ID there.
privacy_message_content_not_stored: PokeFlux does not store the text of your messages.
privacy_message_content_reads: PokeFlux reads messages in channels it can see so it can spot commands and count activity for Pokémon spawns and egg hatching. Some games, such as fishing and duels, also read the reply you type.
privacy_policy_last_updated: PokeFlux keeps this privacy policy under review and posts any changes on this page. It was last updated on {date}.
privacy_providers_cdn: Game images are served from cdn.mewdeko.tech. Your Fluxer client or browser loads them from there, and the server may keep standard access logs with your IP address for 30 days.
privacy_providers_hosting: PokeFlux and this website run on servers rented from Hetzner in Falkenstein, Germany. Requests to the website pass through Cloudflare, which sees your IP address and browser details in order to deliver pages and block attacks.
privacy_providers_sentry: When the website hits an error, a report is sent to Sentry, an error tracking service. A report includes the error message and the page you were on. Sentry also receives your browser type. A small share of page loads are also measured for speed.
privacy_report_complaint: If you want to make a complaint, or feel we have not dealt with your concern properly, you can contact your local data protection authority.
privacy_right_to_access: The right to access: You can ask for a copy of the personal data PokeFlux holds about you.
privacy_right_to_erasure: The right to erasure: You can ask us to delete your personal data.
privacy_right_to_rectification: The right to rectification: You can ask us to correct data you think is wrong or incomplete.
privacy_right_to_restrict: The right to restrict processing: You can ask us to limit how we use your personal data.
privacy_rights_intro: You have rights over your personal data. These include:
privacy_storage_databases: Your game data is stored in a PostgreSQL database. Community settings, mission progress, the bot ban list and Pokémon reference data are stored in MongoDB. Short lived data such as cooldowns and trade locks is kept in Redis.
privacy_trading_actions: If a trade looks high risk, PokeFlux can block it or ban the accounts involved from trading and the market straight away. Staff can review these results on the staff pages of this website and lift bans that were a mistake. Every staff action there is saved in an audit log, including who did it, which account it affected and why.
privacy_trading_checks: PokeFlux checks every trade automatically for signs of cheating, such as alt accounts or real-money trading. It also looks for trades that take advantage of new players. The checks compare the value given by each side and how often two accounts trade with each other. They also use the account age that can be read from a Fluxer user ID. The results are stored as risk scores and flags.
privacy_trading_records: When you finish a trade, PokeFlux records both user IDs and the time, along with the Pokémon, credits, redeems and tokens that changed hands. Market listings record the seller, price, buyer and when the listing was made. Gifts keep a history of who has owned them.
privacy_use_fair_play: Detect cheating in trades and let staff review it
privacy_use_intro: PokeFlux collects your data so that it can:
privacy_use_leaderboard: Show your stats on your trainer card and, unless you hide them, on the public leaderboard
privacy_use_run_game: Run the game and keep your progress between sessions
privacy_we_do_not_sell: We do not sell your data or share it with advertisers.
privacy_your_rights: What are your data protection rights?
terms_by_using: By using PokeFlux or this website, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please stop using PokeFlux.
terms_changes_body: We can change or shut down the Service at any time, and we may update these Terms. If you keep using PokeFlux after a change, you accept the new Terms.
terms_fair_play_alts: Use alt accounts to collect extra rewards or move items between your own accounts
terms_fair_play_automation: Use scripts, macros, selfbots or any other automation to play
terms_fair_play_bugs: Exploit bugs instead of reporting them
terms_fair_play_fluxer: Break Fluxer's Terms of Service while using PokeFlux
terms_fair_play_harass: Harass other players or flood communities with the bot
terms_fair_play_trading_abuse: Use trades, gifts or the market to get around a ban or to take advantage of other players
terms_if_you_have_any_questions: If you have any questions about these Terms, contact us at {email}.
terms_last_updated: These Terms were last updated on {date}.

The bot is released under the GNU General Public License v3 and this website under the GNU Affero General Public License v3. Those licences cover the code. These Terms cover your use of the official Service, which is a separate matter. If you run your own copy, these Terms do not apply to it.
terms_moderation_appeals: If you think a decision was wrong, you can appeal in the support community at https://fluxer.gg/ROQQFi38.
terms_moderation_body: If staff believe you have broken these Terms, they can ban you from trading and the market, or from the bot as a whole. They can also remove your market listings and remove or reset anything on your account, up to the whole account. They can do this with or without a warning. Some trade and market bans are applied automatically by PokeFlux's trade checks and are then reviewed by staff.
terms_no_real_money: Do not buy, sell or trade anything from PokeFlux for real money, or for goods or services outside the game. This includes accounts and items from other games. Offering or advertising such deals is not allowed either.
terms_no_real_value: Pokémon, items, credits, redeems, tokens and everything else in PokeFlux are part of a free game. They have no real-world value and you do not own them. We can change or remove them at any time, for example to balance the game.
terms_no_warranty_body: PokeFlux is a free hobby project provided "as is". We do not promise that it will always work, or that game data will never be lost or rolled back. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for any loss that comes from using it.
terms_service_covers: These Terms cover the official PokeFlux bot on Fluxer and this website at pokeflux.tech (together, the "Service"). Copies of PokeFlux run by other people are not operated by us and are not covered by these Terms. How we handle your data is described in our Privacy Policy.
terms_service_fluxer: You also need to follow Fluxer's own Terms of Service and be old enough to use Fluxer.
